modules.name: Master Agent Factory
modules.description: Master builder for assembling full production agent instances from identity, gateway, memory, tools, and security layers.
modules.usage_example:
from agent_factory.factory import AgentFactory
agent = AgentFactory.create_agent(config, manifest, gateway=gateway, tools=tool_registry)

modules.name: Agent Identity & Configuration
modules.description: Agent identity specifications, manifests, environment configurations, and cost/retry policies.
modules.usage_example:
from agent_factory.core.identity import AgentIdentity, AgentConfig, AgentManifest
identity = AgentIdentity(agent_id='agent-01', name='Researcher')

modules.name: LLM Gateway & Multi-Provider Router
modules.description: Unified LLM gateway with model routing by task complexity, multi-provider fallbacks, streaming, and tool call normalization.
modules.usage_example:
from agent_factory.core.gateway import LLMGateway, LLMRequest, TaskComplexity
gateway = LLMGateway()

cost_mgr.record_usage('gpt-4o', prompt_tokens=150, completion_tokens=50)

modules.name: Prompt Manager & Injection Defense

detector.record_step('action_hash')
